question_or_proposition: What event or condition constitutes 'first discharge' in footnote (2) for triggering WET testing, and how that triggering event governs WET monitoring applicability relative to the 'Once/5 years' measurement frequency shown in the WET table.
required_context: Whole Effluent Toxicity Testing table and footnotes (1)-(3) on Page 4, Part I, Section A
Part II WET testing requirements and additional monitoring and reporting conditions referenced in footnote (3)
notes: The nominated span conditions WET sampling on 'first discharge' while the adjacent table specifies a five-year measurement frequency. Resolving what discharge event triggers the obligation affects whether WET monitoring was required during the evaluation period (Purpose B) and how absent WET results are classified when discharge may or may not have occurred (Purpose C). Purpose A is unaffected because WET entries are report-only, not enforceable numeric limits.
